lessons.contextualText:
Reader: Why does the author use understatement?
Critic: To make the criticism more subtle.

The reviewer described the speaker's choice of words as 'remarkably convenient,' an observation whose significance depended on tone and context. Read literally, the phrase sounded complimentary; in context, it functioned as restrained criticism.
